metadata.labelMethod: source-first supplemental Kazakh labels; all catalogue matches independently enumerated without retrieval/ranking/model output; agent-curated after search implementation
metadata.source: 2GIS listings collected by existing Apify workflow; local demonstration; publication rights for reviews not established
metadata.distance: haversine straight_line, Earth radius 6371000m, radius boundary inclusive
metadata.relevanceRule: Pass every explicit hard filter at case.now, then satisfy labelCriteria exactName and anyTags when supplied. requiredFacts means confirmed true. All matching catalogue IDs are relevant; ranking is not used.
limitations: Source snapshot is incomplete for Astana; labels concern this exact frozen 298-POI catalogue only.
All prices and factual amenities are unknown; positive cases demand neither price bounds nor confirmed amenities.
Source hours are weekly schedules, not live guarantees; no holiday exceptions. Unknown hours allowed only when openNow=false, with warning.
Category/tag labels describe the source listing; they do not establish booking availability, current exhibition content, guest access, exact activity duration or entry price.
Preset locations are fixed UI points, not user device location or verified walking routes.
This is an agent-curated development set, not a blind independent human benchmark.
Kazakh queries are agent-authored supplemental development examples, not observed user queries or native-speaker-verified language.
Source listing descriptions/tags are mostly Russian. Kazakh task wording is curated; original Russian evidence is preserved verbatim. No review opinions are translated or quoted.
These four cases are separate from the frozen 12-RU positive denominator. Existing RU labels are unchanged.
The explicit runtime stub supports five Russian demo phrases only. Unknown Kazakh text clarifies; these artifacts do not claim runtime Kazakh intent or semantic retrieval acceptance.

metrics.recallDefinition: |top5 ∩ relevantIds| / |relevantIds|, macro-average only over these four supplemental KK cases; never merged with frozen RU denominator
metrics.negativePolicy: Existing negative guards remain in frozen RU artifact; this supplemental set has no negative cases.
